app_fee.value: Each NSU college sets its own admissions process; Computing and Halmos charge 50 USD (see program records), while Allopathic Medicine does not state a fee on its Biomedical Sciences Ph.D. pages.

fee_waiver.value: Not stated on NSU graduate or college doctoral admissions pages checked.

gre_general.value: Each college sets its own requirements: Computer Science and Biomedical Sciences do not require GRE scores, whereas Oceanography/Marine Biology requires GRE scores (see program records).

toefl_min.value: NSU requires English proficiency for non-native English speakers, with specific minimum scores set by each college/program (typically TOEFL iBT 79-80 or 4.0 on the new 1-6 scale; see program records).

ielts_min.value: NSU accepts IELTS across most colleges, with specific minimum bands set by each college/program (6.0 where stated; see program records).

english_waiver.value: Applicants whose native or official language is not English must prove English proficiency; university-wide OIA rules list only a U.S. degree or Talk International Level 9 (India is not exempt at any NSU STEM PhD college).
english_waiver.quote: Applicants whose native or official language is not English are required to demonstrate English proficiency in order to be admitted into a degree program. Each program may have additional requirements. | Proof of English language competency can also be in the form of successful completion of a degree at an approved U.S. institution of higher education or passing Level 9 at Talk International Language School.

notes: NSU delegates graduate/doctoral admissions policies to individual colleges (Computing, Halmos, Allopathic Medicine); see program records for college-specific overrides.
